parameters.speaker: Fountain
parameters.text: Coins glint at the bottom, worn smooth by a hundred small hopes. The water is very old and very tired of listening.

parameters.speaker: Notice Board
textVariants: LOST: One sensible hat. If found, please return to the hat's sensible owner. No reward offered because it is, as stated, sensible.
FOUND: A stranger at the library taking notes on everything. Bess says she is 'clever in a way that makes her silent.'
HEARD: The spellblade near the tavern says his sword is 'for decoration.' The tavern regulars disagree, politely.
REMINDER: Do not feed the copper rocks. They do not eat. Whoever told you that lied.
SEEKING: Able hands for the fields. Pay in stories, sometimes in coin.
parameters.cooldownText: You've read today's notices. The board creaks patiently.

parameters.speaker: Picnic Basket
parameters.text: It smells of rosemary and something Bess would call 'indecent butter.' Someone will be back for it. Probably.

parameters.speaker: Scarecrow
parameters.text: Its straw smile has not moved in years. The crows do not look at it. They look past it, like it owes them money.

parameters.speaker: Shrine
textVariants: You press a palm to the stone. It is warmer than a stone has any right to be. Something in your legs stops aching.
The carvings are almost worn off. You trace one anyway. Breath comes easier.
A faint hum. Not sound exactly — more like the stone remembering it was, once, something else.
parameters.cooldownText: The shrine is quiet. You have already asked today.

parameters.speaker: Sign
parameters.text: MARKET SQUARE. Trade fair. Trade quick. Trade loud if you must.

parameters.speaker: Sign
parameters.text: TO THE MINES ->    Wear boots. Bring a light. The rocks do not bite back often.

parameters.speaker: Sign
parameters.text: WELCOME TO MYSTVALE. Please do not feed the familiars. (Someone has scratched out 'please' and replaced it with 'absolutely'.)

textVariants: You strike the dummy. The dummy does not strike back. A small victory but an honest one.
Straw puffs out. Emrys — somewhere — smirks.
You take your stance. The dummy takes the hit. This is a fair arrangement.
parameters.cooldownText: The dummy has had enough of you today.

textVariants: A coin tumbles down. Somewhere far below, water answers with a soft applause.
The well is cold. Your wish goes down politely and does not come back.
You hear a sound like turning pages. The well keeps its counsel.
The coin falls. A second sound follows — like a coin laughing at another coin.
parameters.cooldownText: The well has heard enough of you today.
parameters.insufficientText: You search your pockets. The well is patient but not that patient.
